A human food pantry taking part in the city's pet food programme, which funds free dog and cat food at 22 pantries across the five boroughs. The pet food is new and the pantries do not yet mention it themselves, so ring before travelling and ask whether it has arrived. The city says hours vary by site and change, and to confirm before visiting. The first number is the one the city publishes for the pet food programme itself. In the programme at two sites: 1290 Hoe Ave., Bronx 10459 and 8 East 109th St., Manhattan 10029.
